pr_title: Skip settings validation during desired nodes updates
pr_body:
This commit skips settings validation during desired nodes updates. The issue comes when a setting that needs to be validated depends on a secure setting that cannot be read while the desired nodes are updated. To avoid such issues, we'll skip the settings validations completely.

Closes #96127

issue_context.title: Desired nodes node settings validation fails if a setting depends on a secure setting
issue_context.body: During desired nodes updates the system validates that the provided node settings are valid in order to avoid boot looping issues. If one of the node settings depends on a secure setting, the validation fails even when the secure setting is present and correct.
